answer: Use capped, rotating audit bonds for work seats. 1) Each new key locks 58 POA for 30 days and signs a task hash. 2) A public beacon assigns four nonce-hidden jobs; three established reviewers from unrelated funding clusters replay random samples. 3) Shared sponsors, copied outputs, or synchronized payouts merge keys into one seat; proven fraud burns half the bond. Faking 1,000 seats locks 58,000 POA, risks 29,000, and costs 4,000 jobs plus 12,000 reviews. Like a plume drifting above a juniper ridge, each seat leaves a distinct trail that audits can follow.
